description: Synthetic dev set for the matching pipeline, written for this project. No real visitors, names or businesses. Each set is its own timeline: a record can only link to an earlier record in the same file. Neither the demo SMS nor the sample history appears here.

gold_labels.referral: referral source of the heard story (Unclear when the text does not say)
gold_labels.came_for: tour part named in what the visitor heard (Unclear when generic; null for broken format, not scored)
gold_labels.would_tell: tour part named in answer 2 (null for broken format, not scored)
gold_labels.link: the earlier record whose would-tell story this visitor heard, or null
gold_labels.kind: start: no earlier visitor; link: one earlier visitor told this story; near_miss: an earlier visitor in the same language looks close but is not the source (link is the true source or null); ambiguous: two earlier visitors told the same story, the right output is Unclear; format: answers 1) and 2) not found

split_use: dev: calibration and error analysis only. test: reporting only, never tuned on.

records.raw_text: 1) The owner of our lodge in Nyeri mentioned a family coffee farm up the hill. 2) Bite one of the ripe cherries straight from the bush, they taste sweet like a grape.
1) Unser Fahrer hat uns auf dem Weg nach Nyeri davon erzählt. 2) Die Bohnen trocknen auf langen Netztischen in der Sonne, und man darf sie mit einem Holzrechen wenden.
1) Une amie qui vit à Nairobi nous a conseillé d'y aller. 2) Restez pour la torréfaction : les grains craquent comme du pop-corn dans la poêle.
1) Tuliona video fupi mtandaoni kuhusu shamba hili la kahawa. 2) Kahawa inamiminwa kutoka kwenye chungu cha udongo hadi kwenye vikombe vya bati.
1) Saw photos posted on Instagram by a hiking group. 2) Climb to the top of the slope at sunrise, you can see the mountain above the clouds.

1) Wageni wenzetu kwenye nyumba ya wageni walituambia kwamba maharagwe hukaushwa juani juu ya meza ndefu za neti, na unaweza kuyageuza kwa reki ya mbao. 2) Waambie marafiki wajaribu kusaga kahawa iliyokaangwa kwenye kinu cha mbao.
1) A French couple at our guesthouse told us the beans crack like popcorn when you roast them in the pan. 2) Lunch is served on banana leaves instead of plates, and you eat with your hands.
1) A friend from my running club said to climb the slope at sunrise to see the mountain above the clouds. 2) The children of the family taught us a clapping game and did not want us to leave.

1) Dereva wetu wa teksi alipendekeza tuende kuona miti ya zamani ya kahawa kwenye shamba hili. 2) Chakula cha mchana ni mukimo uliopondwa pamoja na majani ya maboga, kitamu sana.

1) The receptionist at our hotel said the family has lots of children who love meeting visitors. 2) Bring a rain jacket, the afternoon showers come fast in April.
